utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Probably the tool sorting and pickup list—I can help late, but I’ll need the easiest slot to jump into.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—could you take the pickup list? I’ll handle the tool sorting and we can keep it simple for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring the drill, a screwdriver set, and the tape measure? If you have them, please double-check the battery charger too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got the drill, screwdriver set, and tape measure. I’ll check the battery charger too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—yeah, that’d help a lot. I’ve been a bit scattered, so I may have missed what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll make a quick list of what we have and what’s missing, then I’ll let you know what still needs to be gathered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. If you want, I can help sort the donations or carry things over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — sorting would help a lot. I’m just trying to make sure we have enough boxes and room before anything gets brought over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check around for extra boxes and help make some space first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’m still in for it this afternoon — I just heard a couple folks mention it, so I wanted to make sure I had the time right.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should we meet up, and do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks are bringing in tools and spare parts already. If you’re heading over, I’d go early before the good stuff runs out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m headed over early. I can bring my tool tote too if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Gus—your tool tote will be a big help. I’ll tell folks you’re coming early, and they’ll probably be glad to see you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Opal wants, I can invite a few neighbors and remind them to bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that would be great. Please invite a few neighbors and remind them to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll invite a few folks and remind them to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm what kind of help you can actually take on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with hands-on repairs, hauling supplies, and organizing tools or donations. If you’ve got a specific task, I can tell you whether I’m able to take it on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving, Bo. Let’s keep it simple and organized—what do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs and make one simple list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—let’s list the urgent repairs first, then we can sort them by what needs attention right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll tell the others the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: tell them we meet at 9 by the mailboxes, and I’ll bring the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone we meet at 9 by the mailboxes, and you’ll bring the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I can send you the list — it’s mostly the broken gate and the leaky sink.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — that’d help a lot. Send me the list and I’ll take a look at the gate and sink first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and see if anyone can donate tools or a spare afternoon to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for tools and a spare afternoon. I’ll let you know what I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m still rounding up folks for the repair drive—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, put me down — I’ll swing by late if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down. Swing by whenever you can, and I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got a simple list ready—first we need tools, then paint, and after that I’ll sort the rest by priority.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good order. I can help gather tools first, then we can tackle the paint.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great—thank you. I’m thinking Saturday morning around 10, if that works with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 should work well for me. I’ll plan around the school schedule and confirm once I’ve checked the kids’ activities.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good thing to get behind — I can help spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll let everyone know the plan and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — just let me know if you need me to share anything else with folks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and what we’ll need to bring so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help you sort it out — just tell me the schedule and I’ll round up whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive location details—where should we head?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s meet at the community center on Maple, by the side entrance. I’ll be there a little before noon to help you get set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, community center on Maple by the side entrance—I’ve got it. I’ll head there and look for you a little before noon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the list first so I don’t miss anything—what items do you already have noted?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve only got a few things down so far—what’s on your list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we could really use a few rolls of duct tape, some screwdrivers, and any spare nails you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring duct tape and a few screwdrivers, and I’ll check for spare nails too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—I'm still piecing together the details from everyone else. If you know what they need, I’d love to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive—I'm a bit out of the loop too. I should probably check who's organizing it and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Same here—I’m hearing bits and pieces, so let’s compare notes once one of us finds out who’s organizing it and what they need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it’s still on — they’re keeping the repair drive going. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I just wanted to confirm. Keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you grab the spare extension cords and check if the donation bins are by the curb?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll grab the spare extension cords and check the donation bins by the curb. I may need a quick reminder where we kept the cords, though.
